column3: Discussions and feedback on the articles posted on the main Anarchy Online site.
One account, one vote. Note that all polls in here have a limited time frame.
Share your thoughts on the very next changes to hit the live servers.

Land Control, Shadowlands, Jobe and all the other stuff coming in future add-ons.

Get help on getting the game running, whether the problem occurs at installation, patching or login, or when you can't stay in-game for any significant period of time. (NOTE: This is for technical issues only - not gameplay)

Everything from small graphic glitches, to poor performance, to almost game-stopping problems. Note that even though we have split the tech issues, all problems are given high priority. (NOTE: This is for technical issues only - not gameplay)
Learn how to get proficient with the game. No game-play question is too small, though you might want to check the Beginner's Guide first.
How do you make it? Where do you get it? What on Rubi-Ka can I make, anyway? Use this forum to discuss tradeskills and the items everyone is wanting you to make. :)
Share the knowledge about the planet and its riches; hunting fields to roam, sights you shouldn't miss, places to find shops, the best rifle on the market, and other items of interest.
Ask around for that item or service you need so badly, or offer what you can provide for others. This forum is for Rubi-Ka 1. Please use the forum below for Rubi-Ka 2.

Discuss player versus player conflict; its tactics, balance and the general system.
'Everyone' has an opinion about the systems concerning pets, combat, nano formulas, guilds, and so forth. Share and discuss, and please keep it constructive (i.e. no flames).
For broken game-play, be it missions, items, nanos, actions, or anything else. Please report the bugs throug e-mail as well.
'Home' of the Funcom Community Team, consisting of Cosmik, Dai-Galean and Cz, and the place for all kinds of information and discussions they would like to bring up.
Your take on the story so far; its impact, twist and turns, and speculations about the future of Rubi-Ka.
A forum for out-of-game role-playing and storytelling, including player events (but remember the calendar too).
